baseline: VisFly 2024 swarm-crossing, historical official examples/crossing/rl.py without task or algorithm changes
native: Original environment is_success for all three at the same step, x > 10. Original success takes priority on coincident terminal flags; raw flags are retained.
legacy: Historical control-frame garage audit with 0.10 m threshold for peer centers
strict: Three 0.10 m spheres, measured 8 x 2.5 ms integration steps per 20 ms control step; sweep consecutive positions against walls/stage and relative peer trajectories (centers >=0.20 m), cross real aperture and all x > 10 at termination

figure_comparison.window_mean: trapezoidal area / window width after linear interpolation
figure_comparison.measure: original training rollout/success_rate, stored at each rollout without extra smoothing

history: 4/100 prior audit, development cohort; historical corrected environment, control sampling and different configuration; do not pool
recording_selection: First strict success and failure by ascending seed in the final development set, if present. Use fixed alternative cases with explicit provenance only for absent categories. Preserve all seeds.
inference: One training seed, within-garage development and independent seed holdout only.
evaluation_initialization: Create a fresh single-scene official environment for every evaluation seed, after loading the frozen policy reseed and reset. All four initial observation arrays must match across development checkpoints. Specified before any held-out run after detecting stale rendered rigid objects on scene reuse.
